title: Lead-to-OS conversion email drip
notes: Standalone reusable MOFU bridge; launches with the Marketing Webinar with Mark Fisher (Sept 2026) but designed to follow ANY TOFU campaign. Trigger: webinar/lead-magnet signup. Goal: move a lead to a paying member or Trial Offer signup inside OS. Audience = not-yet-customers (prospects). Maps to canonical OS JTBD: 'move a lead through to signup without ever dropping one... without adding another app, login, or surface.' 4-email arc: (1) the last-mile revenue leak; (2) the real 2-step signup workflow (create profile -> Stripe invoice or checkout link); (3) turn your funnel CTA into a Trial Offer signup; (4) 0%-processing close -> hand to sales (MOFU->BOFU handoff). GUARDRAILS: frame OS as the conversion/membership DESTINATION, never as CRM/marketing (deliberate stance); do NOT promise one-click deep-link-to-product (leads land on the pricing page & self-select today; per-product URLs are roadmap ~early 2027); email 4 may cite 0%-processing vs tiered competitors but NOT a published-price edge vs PushPress/Wodify/Walla. Grounded in 8 Avoma demos (Apr-Aug 2026) on the lead->signup pain.
